issues.title: Closed, solid mesh
issues.message: The model has 10 open edges and 10 non-manifold edges, so it is not a sealed solid. The slicer may fill it wrongly or skip parts of it.
issues.suggestion: Close the holes in your CAD tool or run a repair (e.g. Windows 3D Builder, PrusaSlicer 'Repair', or Meshmixer 'Make Solid') and re-export.

issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Nothing on the bottom of this part sits flat on the print bed — it is rounded or tilted. It will need supports and may wobble or detach while printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This is a large part made of thin, spread-out arms (average thickness about 1.80 mm, fills 20% of its outline). Parts like this warp, break and are hard to ship.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the arms, add connecting webs, or split it into sturdier pieces.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 180% of the part's volume (0.9 cm³ of support for 0.5 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 188% of the part's volume (2.0 cm³ of support for 1.1 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 897 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
